clue.text: What fiery folk have: energy during brief altercation

parts.note: brief means short

indicators.note: during places the energy symbol within the word for the altercation

parts.note: a fuss is a row or noisy quarrel
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: Hot-tempered people get caught up in a quick quarrel.
explanation.definitionFit: People with short fuses lose their temper quickly, so hot-headed folk are said to have them.

clue.text: Weaponry General Thumb was never without?

definitions.text: Weaponry General Thumb was never without?

parts.words: Weaponry General Thumb was never without?
parts.note: General Tom Thumb was a famously tiny showman, so his limbs were always little ones; the phrase also names light firearms

explanation.walkthrough: General Tom Thumb was the stage name of Charles Stratton, a very short performer for P. T. Barnum; his 'general' title tempts a military reading.
explanation.definitionFit: Small arms are pistols, rifles and other light weapons carried by hand, a category of military hardware.

clue.text: Roaming seashore on vacation, so try seafood

indicators.note: roaming means wandering about, so the letters are moved around into a new order
a word on vacation is emptied, leaving only its outside letters

parts.note: only its first and last letters are kept

explanation.surface: A beachcomber is told to sample the local shellfish.
explanation.definitionFit: Oysters are shellfish served as a delicacy, a classic example of food from the sea.

clue.text: Asian in love needs initial prod, you say?

indicators.note: you say signals that the letters built are only matched in sound

parts.note: IN and O (love, tennis zero) need a FILLIP, a prod, at the start, giving FILLIP+IN+O

explanation.surface: A lover is told they need a nudge to get things started.
explanation.walkthrough: FILLIP + IN + O, said aloud, is the same as the word for someone from the Philippines, which drops one L.
explanation.definitionFit: A Filipino is a native of the Philippines, a country in Southeast Asia.

clue.text: Believers heading off after ceremony to sample catering, maybe

indicators.note: after puts the shortened believers behind the ceremony

parts.note: a religious service is a ceremony

indicators.note: heading off removes the first letter of the believers

parts.note: Hindus are believers in Hinduism
to try something is to sample it

explanation.surface: Worshippers leave a religious ceremony early to try the buffet.
explanation.definitionFit: Catering is one example of a sector that provides services rather than goods; 'maybe' marks it as an example.

clue.text: Continental gent to engage troops

parts.note: to engage someone, such as a player, is to sign them
OR is short for other ranks, the ordinary troops

explanation.surface: A European gentleman is hired to recruit soldiers.
explanation.definitionFit: Signor is the Italian courtesy title for a man, so it describes a gentleman from mainland Europe.

clue.text: Projectile to shoot wolf

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a short arrow fired from a crossbow
second meaning: to dash off suddenly
third meaning: to gulp food down

explanation.surface: A hunter fires an arrow at a wolf.
explanation.definitionFit: A crossbow fires a bolt; to bolt is to dash away; to bolt food is to eat it greedily, as to wolf it.

clue.text: One-ended pen cover for pupils

parts.note: a blind alley is closed at one end
a fold is a pen for sheep

explanation.surface: A pen with only one open end is used as a schoolroom shield.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pupils' looks like schoolchildren but means the eyes' pupils.
explanation.definitionFit: A blindfold is a strip of cloth tied over the eyes, so it covers the pupils.

clue.text: Most new mums do it, tardily pocketing bill

indicators.note: pocketing means holding the bill inside the word for tardily

parts.note: to arrive late is to arrive tardily
a bill passed by parliament becomes an act

explanation.surface: Mothers of newborns, running late, slip a bill into their pocket.
explanation.definitionFit: Most mothers produce breast milk after giving birth, which is what lactating means.

clue.text: Mariner heard behind another person making descent

indicators.note: behind puts the sounded mariner after the other one

parts.note: another mariner, an AB, short for able seaman

indicators.note: heard means the word for a mariner is taken by its sound

parts.note: a sailor is a mariner

explanation.surface: A sailor is overheard speaking behind someone else on a cliff.
explanation.definitionFit: An abseiler descends a rock face or building on a rope, so is someone making a descent.

clue.text: Problem settled in Communications centre, no question

indicators.note: in puts the word for settled inside the shortened centre
no means the question letter is left out

parts.note: GCHQ is Government Communications Headquarters, the UK intelligence centre in Cheltenham
a bird that has settled has lit

explanation.surface: A fault is fixed at a communications hub without any queries.
explanation.definitionFit: A glitch is a small technical fault or hitch, so it is a minor problem.

clue.text: Story ultimately relayed in song

parts.note: a story is a lie

indicators.note: ultimately means the final letter is taken

parts.note: its last letter

explanation.surface: A tale is finally passed on through music.
explanation.definitionFit: A lied is a German art song, usually for voice and piano, as written by Schubert.

clue.text: Stiffly formal or cryptically relaxed from the start?

parts.note: prim means stiffly proper

indicators.note: cryptically means the letters are disguised by being reordered

parts.note: laid-back, or laid, means relaxed

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether to be formal or laid-back from the outset.
explanation.definitionFit: Primordial means existing at the very beginning of time, the original state.

clue.text: Doctor considered dropping over, and withdrew

indicators.note: to doctor something is to tamper with it, so the letters are rearranged
dropping means the over letter leaves the fodder before it is rearranged

parts.note: O is the cricket abbreviation for over

explanation.surface: A physician thought about falling over and then backed out.
explanation.definitionFit: To rescind a law or decision is to revoke or cancel it, so rescinded means withdrew.

clue.text: Hazard youngster comes across

parts.note: to hazard is to chance or risk
a son is a youngster

explanation.surface: A danger is faced by a young person.
explanation.definitionFit: To chance on something is to find it by accident, the same as coming across it.

clue.text: Fighter backing king of Britain at outset

indicators.note: backing means the whole string is read in reverse

parts.note: rex is Latin for king, as in royal signatures
o' is a short form of of

indicators.note: at outset means the first letter is taken

parts.note: its first letter

explanation.surface: A warrior supports the British monarch from the start.
explanation.definitionFit: A boxer is a fighter who uses fists in the ring, a sporting combatant.

clue.text: Star in retro production to get makeover artist?

indicators.note: in means the star is placed inside the reworked letters
a production reworks the material, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: a nova is a star that suddenly brightens

explanation.surface: A celebrity in a retro show gets a makeover.
explanation.definitionFit: A renovator refurbishes buildings, giving them a makeover, so is jokingly an artist of makeovers.

clue.text: Increasingly hare-brained acts crippled bank

indicators.note: crippled means damaged, so the letters are put out of order

parts.note: a bank of seats is a tier

explanation.surface: Ever more reckless deeds bring down a bank.
explanation.definitionFit: Scatty means scatterbrained or flighty, so scattier is more hare-brained.

clue.text: Dumpy crew eliminating last outsider in tournament

indicators.note: eliminating last removes the crew's final letter

parts.note: a squad is a team or crew

indicators.note: the outside letter at the front of the word

parts.note: its first letter

explanation.surface: A short, stocky team is knocked out of a competition.
explanation.definitionFit: Squat describes something short and thickset, the same as dumpy.

clue.text: Leave rear of theatre this way, of course

parts.note: to quit is to leave

indicators.note: the rear is the final letter

parts.note: its last letter
so means in this way

explanation.surface: A theatregoer is told to exit by the back, naturally.
explanation.definitionFit: Quite so is an expression of agreement, like saying certainly or naturally.

clue.text: Inexpensive way to sell a lot?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a ... price is cheap
second meaning: an auctioneer's ... of the hammer completes the sale of a lot

explanation.walkthrough: 'a lot' looks like 'a great deal' but is an auction lot.
explanation.definitionFit: Bargain prices are called knockdown, and at auction a lot is sold when it is knocked down to the bidder.

clue.text: Like eggs, half-a-dozen coated in old mould

indicators.note: coated in means the number is wrapped by the other letters

parts.note: to mould is to form
VI is six in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: Six eggs are covered in ancient mould.
explanation.definitionFit: Oviform means egg-shaped, from the Latin ovum, egg.

clue.text: Outstanding amateur

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a bill still owed

explanation.walkthrough: 'Outstanding amateur' reads as praise for a gifted hobbyist.
explanation.definitionFit: An unpaid bill is outstanding, and an unpaid worker is an amateur or volunteer.

clue.text: Abuse Frenchman caught slashing fixed discount

parts.note: M is short for monsieur, a Frenchman

indicators.note: slashing means cutting into the shuffled letters
fixed means rigged, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: C is the cricket abbreviation for caught

explanation.surface: A Frenchman is caught cutting a rigged price reduction.
explanation.definitionFit: Misconduct is improper behaviour, especially abuse of an official position.

clue.text: Closure of bank that is opposed to capital

indicators.note: closure means the end letter

parts.note: its last letter
i.e. is short for id est, that is
v is short for versus, opposed to

explanation.surface: A bank's shutting is resisted by the city.
explanation.definitionFit: Kiev, now usually spelt Kyiv, is the capital city of Ukraine.

clue.text: Hostess's porridge is hardly dipped into

indicators.note: dipped into means a stretch of the words is sampled from within them

explanation.surface: A hostess barely dips into her porridge.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's of 'Hostess's' is 'is', a link joining definition to wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: A geisha is a Japanese woman trained to entertain male guests, a professional hostess.

clue.text: After trouble, firm invested in kitsch morning wear

indicators.note: invested in means put inside the tacky word

parts.note: tat is tasteless kitsch

indicators.note: after puts the firm behind the trouble

parts.note: to ail is to trouble
Co. is short for company, a firm

explanation.surface: After difficulties, a company puts money into tacky goods.
explanation.definitionFit: A tailcoat is the formal coat with tails worn with morning dress at weddings.

clue.text: Couple running round island in judge's wake

indicators.note: in the judge's wake means following the judge, so the rest comes after

parts.note: J is short for judge

indicators.note: round means the word for running goes around the island letter

parts.note: a machine that is on is running

explanation.surface: Two people run round an island behind a judge.
explanation.definitionFit: To couple things is to join or link them together.

clue.text: One's imagining Romeo with shoddy readymade clothing

indicators.note: clothing means the reworked letters wrap around Romeo
shoddy means badly made, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: Romeo is R in the radio alphabet

explanation.surface: A dreamer pictures Romeo wearing cheap off-the-peg clothes.
explanation.definitionFit: A daydreamer is someone lost in fantasy, always imagining things while awake.
